name: Easy migration example
description: Bundled example submodule: four reference EasyMigration plugins that port Drupal 7 tags, users, pages, and articles into Drupal 10/11.
project_description: Example submodule of Easy Migration. Ships four EntityMigration plugins under src/Plugin/EasyMigration demonstrating how to port Drupal 7 content into Drupal 10/11 via plain SQL and the Entity API: tags (taxonomy_term), users (with password hashes and roles), pages (node), and articles (node with tags and images). Depends on the easy_migration base module. Its info.yml description and package are left as unfilled '@todo' placeholders by the maintainer.
